title: 2026-27 Topps NBA Hoops Basketball: Checklist & Buying Guide
summary: Everything you need to know about 2026-27 Topps NBA Hoops: release dates, box prices, checklist details, and top rookie cards from Acuff, Dybantsa, and Boozer.
body_markdown:
Panini lost their NBA license in October of 2025, when Topps continued their takeover of the sports landscape. That’s why it might come as a surprise to many that the iconic[NBA](https://courtyard.io/vending-machine?category=basketball) Hoops set is still alive—licensed—and well.


Unlike famed sets from both Panini and Topps,[the NBA itself owns the Hoops trademark](https://www.sportscollectorsdaily.com/notes-topps-to-take-over-nba-hoops-brand-griffin-now-card-print-run-pack-pulled-autographs-now-part-of-ebays-direct-to-grading-program/) .


2026 marks the second edition of the modern Hoops franchise orchestrated by Topps, with 2026-27 Topps NBA Hoops Basketball (hobby) set to release on December 10th, with retail following a week later on December 17th. It also marks the first appearance of[AJ Dybantsa](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=AJ%20Dybantsa&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) ,[Darryn Peterson](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Darryn%20Peterson&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) ,[Cameron Boozer](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Cameron%20Boozer&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) ,[Caleb Wilson](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Caleb%20Wilson&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) ,[Darius Acuff Jr.](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Darius%20Acuff%20Jr.) , and the rest of the highly touted 2026 rookie class in the set, autos and all.


When it comes to pricing, a hobby box costs $189.99 at presale and includes one guaranteed auto, $70 less than last year’s $259.99 presale price—which comes as a surprise given[the price increases for Flagship Basketball](https://courtyard.io/blog/post/2026-27-topps-flagship-basketball-rookies-guide) .


While Courtyard will be adding cards from 2026-27 NBA Hoops to our vault as soon as they’re pulled,[graded](https://courtyard.io/blog/post/is-courtyard-io-legit-heres-what-you-need-to-know) , and shipped, there’s already plenty of information about the set, from the checklist to past[NBA Hoops cards](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=NBA%20Hoops&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_fmv_high_to_low) on Courtyard, to review.


## **What is Topps NBA Hoops?**


Hoops is one of Topps’ entry-level NBA sets: a 300-card base set with a deep roster of inserts and parallels that are built for collectors who want to chase cards at a lower price point than the season’s first-comer—Flagship Basketball. Even Topps’ own marketing for the product calls it a “[familiar, accessible entry point into NBA collecting](https://ripped.topps.com/topps-hoops-basketball-history/) .”


Prior to Topps, Hoops was launched during the 1989-90 NBA season with two series (300 and 52, respectively), and[David Robinson’s #138 rookie card](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=David%20Robinson%20%23138&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_fmv_high_to_low) still serves as the year’s best base card. Panini printed Hoops for more than a decade before the license recently moved to Topps, who launched[their first-ever edition of NBA Hoops earlier in 2026](https://ripped.topps.com/topps-hoops-best-basketball-cards/) . Now, just five weeks after the release of Flagship Basketball, we’ve got 2026-27 NBA Hoops.


## **Top 2026-27 NBA Hoops Rookie Cards to Chase**


The 2026 NBA rookie class has been hyped unlike any other in recent memory—and thus far, they’ve largely delivered.


Per[the official NBA rookie ladder](https://www.nba.com/news/kia-rookie-ladder-november-25-2026) , Kings guard Darius Acuff Jr. has the top spot, averaging 24.6 points per game, 7.2 assists per game, and 3.4 rebounds per game on 40.3%, 32.1%, and 83.1% splits. The Sacramento Kings aren’t winning games, but Acuff is balling.


Not every rookie starts in their first season, and the vast majority don’t put up star-level, let alone in the first dozen or so games, but the top of the 2026 class are all doing just that. These kids are special, and collectors have taken notice.


Rookie autographs come from three inserts within the set: Rookie Signatures (33 cards, hobby-exclusive), Rookie First Signs (37 cards, retail-exclusive), and Base Hoops Signatures Rookies (45 cards).

## **2026-27 Topps NBA Hoops Checklist Breakdown**


In total,[2026-27 Topps NBA Hoops](https://www.basketballcardinsider.com/post/2026-27-topps-hoops-basketball-preview) has a 1,115-card checklist between the 300-card base set, the 450 inserts, and the 365 autographs. However, no memorabilia cards are included in Hoops, a rare omission in the modern era.


- **Autographs:** Hoops Signs (50 cards, hobby-exclusive) returns with a retro, fluorescent design. With on-card autographs, it’s one to chase. Parallels range from Purple (/99) to Platinum (1/1). Hyper Signatures (49 cards) is retail-exclusive, with Base Hoops Signatures (53 cards) and Curated Signatures (78 cards) filling out the rest, along with 20 multi-player rookie autographs.
- **Case hits:**[Cathedral (retail), Checkmate, Elevation Nation, Hooptopia, Kaleido Court, and Oasis](https://www.checklistinsider.com/2026-27-topps-nba-hoops-basketball) are the case hit inserts to chase.
- **Inserts:** Finals Pursuit is the largest at 100 cards, with the later rounds numbered from /399 down to /100. Bounce House, Digitized, Hardwired, Net To Net, and Smooth Operators are among the others.
- **Parallels:** Hobby boxes have Pixel Burst (Magenta /399 down to Red /5, plus a Platinum 1/1), while retail has Light Burst (Magenta /350 down to Red /5, plus a Platinum 1/1), with Green Hoops in Value and Mega boxes and Orange Hoops in Hanger boxes.


Hobby boxes are the only format with a stated autograph guarantee—largely because there are no jumbo boxes for this release.


Every hobby box comes with one auto, while Hanger, Blaster, and Mega boxes are the luck of the draw.

## **2026-27 Topps NBA Hoops Basketball Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)**


### **When does 2026-27 Topps NBA Hoops Basketball release?**


Hobby, Hanger and Value boxes are available beginning on December 10th. Mega boxes are available a week later on December 17th.


### **How many autographs are in a 2026-27 NBA Hoops hobby box?**


One. Only the Hobby box guarantees an auto, with no jumbo boxes available for this release.


### **How many cards are in the set?**


There are 1,115 cards in the 2026-27 Topps NBA Hoops set, including a 300-card base set with 50 rookies.


### **How much does a Hoops hobby box cost?**


The presale price for a hobby box of 2026-27 Topps NBA Hoops is $189.99.


### **Does 2026-27 Topps NBA Hoops have memorabilia or patch cards?**


No, 2026-27 Topps NBA Hoops does not include jersey or memorabilia cards, keeping the focus entirely on base cards, parallels, inserts, and autographs for this entry-level set.
